verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ חַלְּצֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה מֵאָדָ֣ם רָ֑ע מֵאִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ḥal·lə·ṣê·nî Yah·weh mê·’ā·ḏām rā‘ mê·’îš ḥă·mā·sîm tin·ṣə·rê·nî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David Rescue me O LORD from evil men Protect me from men of violence
verses.literalPt: LIVRA-ME, ó SENHOR, do homem mau; guarda-me do homem violento,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָע֣וֹת בְּלֵ֑ב כָּל־ י֝֗וֹם יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ḥā·šə·ḇū rā·‘ō·wṯ bə·lêḇ kāl- yō·wm yā·ḡū·rū mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long
verses.literalPt: Que pensa o mal no coração; continuamente se ajuntam para a guerra.

verses.original: שָֽׁנֲנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָם֮ כְּֽמוֹ־ נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·nă·nū lə·šō·w·nām kə·mōw- nā·ḥāš ḥă·maṯ ‘aḵ·šūḇ ta·ḥaṯ śə·p̄ā·ṯê·mōw se·lāh
verses.literal: They sharpen their tongues like snakes the venom of vipers is on their lips Selah
verses.literalPt: Aguçaram as línguas como a serpente; o veneno das víboras está debaixo dos seus lábios. (Selá.)

verses.original: שָׁמְרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה׀ מִ֘ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע מֵאִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵ֑נִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִדְח֥וֹת פְּעָמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rê·nî Yah·weh mî·ḏê rā·šā‘ mê·’îš ḥă·mā·sîm tin·ṣə·rê·nî ’ă·šer ḥā·šə·ḇū liḏ·ḥō·wṯ pə·‘ā·māy
verses.literal: Guard me O LORD from the hands of the wicked Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble . . .
verses.literalPt: Guarda-me, ó SENHOR, das mãos do ímpio; guarda-me do homem violento; os quais se propuseram transtornar os meus passos.

verses.original: טָֽמְנֽוּ־ גֵאִ֨ים׀ פַּ֡ח לִ֗י וַחֲבָלִ֗ים פָּ֣רְשׂוּ רֶ֭שֶׁת לְיַד־ מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָֽׁתוּ־ לִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ṭā·mə·nū- ḡê·’îm paḥ lî wa·ḥă·ḇā·lîm pā·rə·śū re·šeṯ lə·yaḏ- ma‘·gāl mō·qə·šîm šā·ṯū- lî se·lāh
verses.literal: The proud hide a snare for me the cords of their net are spread along the path and lures are set out for me Selah
verses.literalPt: Os soberbos armaram-me laços e cordas; estenderam a rede ao lado do caminho; armaram-me laços corrediços. (Selá.)

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהוָה אֵ֣לִי אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.literal: I say to the LORD You are my God Hear O LORD . . . my cry for help
verses.literalPt: Eu disse ao SENHOR: Tu és o meu Deus; ouve a voz das minhas súplicas, ó SENHOR.

verses.original: יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּי֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ‘ōz yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî sak·kō·ṯāh lə·rō·šî bə·yō·wm nā·šeq
verses.literal: O GOD the Lord the strength of my salvation You shield my head in the day of battle
verses.literalPt: Ó DEUS o Senhor, fortaleza da minha salvação, tu cobriste a minha cabeça no dia da batalha.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמ֥וֹ אַל־ תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tit·tên Yah·weh ma·’ă·way·yê rā·šā‘ zə·mā·mōw ’al- tā·p̄êq yā·rū·mū se·lāh
verses.literal: Grant not O LORD the desires of the wicked do not promote their evil plans lest they be exalted Selah
verses.literalPt: Não concedas, ó SENHOR, ao ímpio os seus desejos; não promovas o seu mau propósito, para que não se exalte. (Selá.)

verses.literal: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused
verses.literalPt: Quanto à cabeça dos que me cercam, cubra-os a maldade dos seus lábios.

verses.original: יָמִיטוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בַּֽל־ יָקֽוּמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yå̄·mī·ṭū ‘ă·lê·hem ge·ḥā·lîm bā·’êš yap·pi·lêm bə·ma·hă·mō·rō·wṯ bal- yā·qū·mū
verses.literal: May burning coals fall on them may they be thrown into the fire into the miry pits never to rise again
verses.literalPt: Caiam sobre eles brasas vivas; sejam lançados no fogo, em covas profundas, para que se não tornem a levantar.

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל־ יִכּ֪וֹן בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ־ חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš lā·šō·wn bal- yik·kō·wn bā·’ā·reṣ ’îš- ḥā·mās rā‘ yə·ṣū·ḏen·nū lə·maḏ·ḥê·p̄ōṯ
verses.literal: May no slanderer . . . . . . be established in the land may calamity hunt down . . . the man of violence
verses.literalPt: Não terá firmeza na terra o homem de má língua; o mal perseguirá o homem violento até que seja desterrado.

verses.original: יָדַעְתִּ כִּֽי־ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְ֭הוָה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yå̄·ḏaʿ·ti kî- ya·‘ă·śeh Yah·weh dîn ‘ā·nî miš·paṭ ’eḇ·yō·nîm
verses.literal: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy
verses.literalPt: Sei que o SENHOR sustentará a causa do oprimido, e o direito do necessitado.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִים יוֹד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יֵשְׁב֥וּ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ṣad·dî·qîm yō·w·ḏū liš·me·ḵā yê·šə·ḇū yə·šā·rîm ’eṯ- pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Surely the righteous will praise Your name the upright . . . will dwell in Your presence
verses.literalPt: Assim os justos louvarão o teu nome; os retos habitarão na tua presença.
